messages.author: c60bcb6df5eb5536
messages.subject: problem with libblas shared library
parts:
Hi All,

I have previously gotten Rapache working on my Ubuntu machine for
development (9.10, 32 bit), but now are trying to set it up on an
openSuse 64bit machine for actually serving up R web interfaces. R has
been compiled as a shared library. When compiling Rapache, we don't
get any errors. However, when we go to load the module in Apache, it
complains that it cannot find libRblas.so, that the file and directory
don't exist.

an LDD on mod_R.so gives:

libR.so => /usr/local/lib64/R/lib/libR.so (0x00002aaaaabbc000)
libapreq2.so.2 =>
/home/rouchka/build/rapache-1.1.9/libapreq2/library/.libs/libapreq2.so.2
(0x00002aaaab019000)
libc.so.6 => /lib64/tls/libc.so.6 (0x00002aaaab147000)
libRblas.so => not found
libgfortran.so.0 => /usr/lib64/libgfortran.so.0 (0x00002aaaab373000)
libm.so.6 => /lib64/tls/libm.so.6 (0x00002aaaab4cd000)
libreadline.so.5 => /lib64/libreadline.so.5 (0x00002aaaab625000)
libdl.so.2 => /lib64/libdl.so.2 (0x00002aaaab760000)
libapr-0.so.0 => /usr/lib64/libapr-0.so.0 (0x00002aaaab863000)
libaprutil-0.so.0 => /usr/lib64/libaprutil-0.so.0 (0x00002aaaab98a000)
libgdbm.so.3 => /usr/lib64/libgdbm.so.3 (0x00002aaaabaa3000)
libdb-4.3.so => /usr/lib64/tls/libdb-4.3.so (0x00002aaaabba8000)
libexpat.so.0 => /usr/lib64/libexpat.so.0 (0x00002aaaabd9c000)
librt.so.1 => /lib64/tls/librt.so.1 (0x00002aaaabec0000)
libcrypt.so.1 => /lib64/libcrypt.so.1 (0x00002aaaabfc8000)
libnsl.so.1 => /lib64/libnsl.so.1 (0x00002aaaac102000)
libpthread.so.0 => /lib64/tls/libpthread.so.0 (0x00002aaaac218000)
/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 (0x0000555555554000)
libncurses.so.5 => /lib64/libncurses.so.5 (0x00002aaaac32d000)

libRblas.so does exist in /usr/local/lib64/R/lib.

Doing the same on the working one in Ubuntu gives:
linux-gate.so.1 => (0xb78d6000)
libR.so => /usr/lib/R/lib/libR.so (0xb75a1000)
libapreq2.so.3 => /usr/local/apache2/lib/libapreq2.so.3 (0xb7593000)
libc.so.6 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/libc.so.6 (0xb743f000)
libblas.so.3gf => /usr/lib/libblas.so.3gf (0xb73b7000)
libgfortran.so.3 => /usr/lib/libgfortran.so.3 (0xb72f0000)
libm.so.6 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/libm.so.6 (0xb72ca000)
libreadline.so.6 => /lib/libreadline.so.6 (0xb7291000)
libpcre.so.3 => /lib/libpcre.so.3 (0xb7260000)
libbz2.so.1.0 => /lib/libbz2.so.1.0 (0xb724d000)
libz.so.1 => /lib/libz.so.1 (0xb7237000)
libdl.so.2 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/libdl.so.2 (0xb7233000)
/lib/ld-linux.so.2 (0xb78d7000)
libapr-1.so.0 => /usr/local/apache2/lib/libapr-1.so.0 (0xb7209000)
libaprutil-1.so.0 => /usr/local/apache2/lib/libaprutil-1.so.0 (0xb71ea000)
libexpat.so.0 => /usr/local/apache2/lib/libexpat.so.0 (0xb71c6000)
librt.so.1 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/librt.so.1 (0xb71bd000)
libcrypt.so.1 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/libcrypt.so.1 (0xb718b000)
libpthread.so.0 => /lib/tls/i686/cmov/libpthread.so.0 (0xb7172000)
libgcc_s.so.1 => /lib/libgcc_s.so.1 (0xb7154000)
libncurses.so.5 => /lib/libncurses.so.5 (0xb711b000)

In the first instance (not working), it seems rApache is looking to
use libRblas.so, which does exist on the machine, but we can't see any
way to actually set the path in any of the configure options. However,
in the second case it is using libblas.so.3gf.

Has anybody else encountered this or know of a solution?

Thanks,

-Robert

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: problem with libblas shared library
parts:
What does ldd /usr/local/lib64/R/lib/libR.so say about libRblas.so?
Also check up on your scripts that start apache; they sometimes clamp
down on environment variables like LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Also, scope out
your /etc/ld.so.conf. You may need to add /usr/local/lib64/R/lib.

Jeff

One thing to note is that when building rApache on linux, the path to
libR.so is encoded into mod_R.so via the linker flag -rpath.

Jeff
